Thanks again for the call today — summary and action items below.

On Wed, Sep 9, 2026 at 14:00 Elena Park <elena@harborpoint.com> wrote:
> Thanks for taking this — HarborPoint is preparing for a SOC 2 readiness review and we'd like to run a brief intake...

Meeting summary (key points):
- Scope: Redwood will cover hosted inference (hosted API) and Redwood Dedicated for the named tenancy. Staging environments are out of scope unless explicitly requested.
- Artifacts we will provide: latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted for public distribution), CAIQ matrix export, SIG partial answers for infra & operations, runbook for evidence pull.
- Logs: Redwood can provide time-bounded log exports (gzipped JSON/NDJSON) for a requested 7-day window. We can also provide console access for read-only queries under an NDA, but first-hand export is the faster path.
- Preferred sample format: NDJSON with ISO timestamps and fields: request_id, model_id, user_id (redacted as needed), event, timestamp, shard_id. David will share a sample file and the extraction script.
- Timeline:
  • Action: HarborPoint to upload completed questionnaire to shared Drive (by 2026-09-10).
  • Action: Redwood to produce sample-log-extract.txt and extraction script (by 2026-09-13).
  • Action: Redwood to surface SOC 2 report export and CAIQ (by 2026-09-15).
  • Follow-up runbook call (opt): week of 2026-09-20 if HarborPoint needs a live handoff.

Action owners:
- HarborPoint (Elena / Marco): upload harborpoint-prelim-answers.xlsx into Drive + flag any special PII handling requirements (due 2026-09-10).
- Redwood (Marissa): confirm legal/DPA contact and provide DPA template (due 2026-09-13).
- Redwood (David): share extraction script + sample-log-extract.txt in Drive (due 2026-09-13).
- Redwood (Jonas): upload CAIQ export & SOC 2 access instructions (due 2026-09-15).

Attachments delivered/mentioned: redwood-soc2-intake-guide.pdf, meeting-agenda-20260909.ics.

Next steps/notes:
• Marissa: I'll loop Legal on procurement redline questions (Marissa, please add the DPA link to the Drive).
• David: sample format attached to this thread (sample-log-extract.txt) and I included a short extraction command in the Drive README. If HarborPoint prefers SIEM-ready CSV, we can provide that transformation as well.

If anything above looks off, reply-all and we'll correct. Otherwise we'll treat dates as the working targets.

Thanks,
